description:
Refactor the 'PasswordValidatorTest' class in the 'security-utils' project. The current test class contains 8 redundant test methods that all perform the same validation logic with different inputs. Your goal is to replace these 8 individual methods with a single JUnit 5 '@ParameterizedTest' that covers all the same scenarios using a data source (like '@CsvSource').

Ensure that:
1. All original test cases are preserved in the parameterized test.
2. The redundant individual test methods are removed.
3. All 8 tests still pass when run.

The project is located at ~/IdeaProjects/security-utils.
